_comment: Human overrides for scripts/rate_sources.py. Keys are feed ids from sources.json or entry names from where_to_look.json. Any of primacy, independence, energy_focus, timeliness, verifiability (0-3), plus best_for and verified (who checked, when).

cisa.best_for: ICS advisories and KEV: the authoritative 'is it exploited' answer for US operators
cisa.verified: Carolina's project notes 2026-11-04; feed blocks automated pulls (403), read the site

incibe-sci.best_for: the same ICS advisories as CISA, a day later, from a feed that works
incibe-sci.verified: reviewed 2026-11-05: delivered 4 energy items this week incl. Siemens, Welotec, Phoenix Contact

certua.best_for: the primary source on attacks against Ukrainian energy; a party to the war, attributions to Russia

certpl.best_for: Poland 2025 distributed-energy campaign and Russian-linked activity against Poland

therecord.best_for: nation-state and ransomware actors; owned by Recorded Future, editorially independent

industrialcyber.best_for: regulator and vendor notices for OT, fast; weight vendor announcements accordingly
industrialcyber.verified: reviewed 2026-11-05: 7 of 18 energy items this week, 3 vendor announcements

utilitydive.best_for: US utility policy and regulation framing (CISA 2015, grid-component order); blocks automated pulls
utilitydive.verified: reviewed 2026-11-05: both legal items unverifiable because the page returns 403

bleeping.best_for: first and fastest on ransomware and device exploitation (Zyxel); confirm counts elsewhere

hackernews.best_for: breadth for the wide bucket; relays vendor research (VulnCheck, Binarly) quickly

kaspersky-ics.best_for: deep ICS vulnerability research (Dustman/Bapco); Russian vendor, soft on Russian attribution

arxiv-cr.best_for: what researchers are probing before journals publish; never a fact source

mit-tr-climate.best_for: data-centre load and US energy policy; not a security outlet

heise.best_for: German utilities and EU regulation; independently corroborated the Siemens IoT2050 attacks

NERC Reliability Standards (CIP-002 to C.best_for: the enforceable version of every CIP standard with effective dates

CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities cat.best_for: exploited yes/no with date; fetched automatically by enrich_cves.py

NVD.best_for: CVSS and references per CVE; fetched automatically

Federal Register.best_for: the text of any US rule or executive order; the only answer to 'is it final'
